assets.name: ob-hero-packshot
assets.prompt: Studio product photography of a premium white glass jar labelled 'OralBiome Pro' in clean sans-serif typography, sitting centred on a seamless deep navy #1A3B5C background. A single translucent white probiotic lozenge floats mid-air above the jar, catching a subtle warm gold #C9A84C specular highlight. Shallow depth of field, cinematic 16:9 composition with generous negative space on the left for overlay text. Premium pharmaceutical/cosmeceutical aesthetic, clinical minimalism, ultra-sharp product focus. No visible hands, props, or additional text beyond the jar label.
